name: Angela Plowhead
occupation: Psychologist, Small Business Owner & Founder Veteran Suicide Prevention Nonprofit

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Plowhead lists her occupation as psychologist, small business owner and founder of a veteran suicide prevention nonprofit, with a background as an Air Force signals intelligence analyst and VA psychologist.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Psychologist, Small Business Owner & Founder Veteran Suicide Prevention Nonprofit. Occupational Background: Air Force Signals Intelligence Analyst. VA Psychologist.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

bio.statement: Plowhead lists prior governmental experience as VA supervisory psychologist, chair of the Marion County Soil & Water Conservation District and member of the Marion County Water Quality Advisory Committee.
bio.excerpt: VA Supervisory Psychologist. Chair, Marion County Soil & Water Conservation District. Marion County Water Quality Advisory Committee.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41
